record.title: Validate a three-block ordinary option control
record.intent: Extend the proven stock consumer contract to a 48-byte token before expanding individual option coverage.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before implementation. Preserve existing single-option and capability evidence; use unchanged stock Auklet and the validated synthetic FlexA seed.
Prepare an explicit BWU05T08 wrong-name fixture with 48 decoded bytes and the stock low-nibble-first wire encoding. Keep synthetic identity, key material and permanent type/time semantics unchanged.

Use actual stock decoder controls and three observed AES consumer blocks. Require the exact intended padded plaintext, original false validation, rejection result, unchanged full 14-entry catalog, no new option file and preserved rejected-attempt deltas.
Preserve real ART/JNI/factory, actual private serialization and current isolation/health controls. No physical access, derived D library, bundle option, trial expiration or new model personality.

Generalize only the declared token size, option metadata and observation/verification paths needed for the bounded catalog. Do not weaken earlier checks or substitute native results. Stop on the first mismatch and evaluate before another run.
Commit and push this control conclusion before the cumulative positive catalog experiment.
acceptance: The 48-byte consumer negative control is established
or its exact first failure is preserved.
